author: sfkwww
body:
So, i've been gone for a while, mainly because avicus was getting boring, and after waiting for avicore for over 3 months, i was getting tired of waiting too. Now, when it finally arrives, i was honestly not that impressed, and i was not planning on staying. But then i found the McZone servers :D

So yea, you're most likely going to find me on the McZone servers.
